name: Hotel Alpin Tyrol
beschreibung: The Hotel Alpin Tyrol welcomes holidaymakers to a sunny, peaceful setting in St. Johann in Tirol, nestled in the heart of the Kitzbühel Alps. Styled in a contemporary Tyrolean alpine design, the guest rooms and family suites provide supreme comfort, complete with modern bathrooms, flat-screen TVs, free Wi-Fi, and private balconies framing panoramic vistas of the Kitzbüheler Horn and the Wilder Kaiser. Following outdoor pursuits, the on-site spa haven featuring an indoor swimming pool, Finnish sauna, steam room, and sunbathing lawn in the garden offers soothing regeneration. The hotel dining room treats guests to generous breakfast buffets and delicious Tyrolean evening dinners. St. Johann's charming town centre with its boutiques and bakeries is easily reached. In winter, ski buses connect swiftly to the St. Johann cable cars and Kitzbühel. In summer, boundless hiking and biking trails await.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy alpine hotel in St. Johann in Tirol featuring an indoor pool, saunas, panoramic garden, and close to the Kitzbühel Alps.
